analysis.summary_en: Context that stays with the work — across sessions, agents, and people.
highlights: Coding tasks (SWE-bench Pro paired comparison): approximately 225.32 million input tokens per 100 tasks with PowerContext on, versus 302.18 million with it off — approximately 25.4% fewer i…
Long-conversation memory (LoCoMo; 1,540 scored questions across categories 1–4): 90.78% accuracy, against 52.9% for full-context replay — +37.88 points over full context.
Retrieval quality (LoCoMo Plus), native PowerContext against PowerContext with Jev candidate filtering after retrieval.
For a Server on another machine, use HTTPS or follow the remote connection guide.
analysis.summary_zh_native: 让上下文跟着工作走 —— 跨越会话、跨 Agent、跨人。
highlights_zh: 编码任务（SWE-bench Pro 配对对照）：开启 PowerContext 后每 100 题约消耗 2.2532 亿输入 token，关闭时约为 3.0218 亿 —— 输入 token 约减少 25.4%，即每 100 题约少用 7,686 万。
长对话记忆（LoCoMo；类别 1–4 的 1,540 个计分问题）：准确率 90.78%，全量上下文重放为 52.9% —— 相对后者 +37.88 个百分点。
召回质量（LoCoMo Plus）：原生 PowerContext 对比检索后用 Jev 做候选筛选。
一个 Server，同一份契约的多个视图。
